document.extraction_note: The uploaded PDF had 744,217 trailing null bytes after the %%EOF marker which made it unreadable by standard PDF parsers; the padding was trimmed before extraction. All text below is transcribed from the brochure. Nothing has been inferred or invented; fields the brochure does not state are marked null or listed under not_stated_in_brochure.

roads_and_layout.description: Crafted with 80 and 60-feet roads stretching over 4 kms, it seamlessly blends a vibrant commercial hub with elegant residential plots.

infrastructure.philosophy: Smart Underground Infrastructure - world-class underground systems that ensure safety, reliability and convenience.
infrastructure.electricity: Enjoy uninterrupted power with insulated underground cables running along concrete ducts. No messy poles, no storm damage just safe and reliable electricity for your home and business.
infrastructure.internet: Stay connected with high-speed fiber optics laid securely underground. Experience seamless browsing, video calls, streaming, and smart home connectivity without interruptions.
infrastructure.sewage_and_stp: Underground Sewage pipe lines laid at the center of the roads and connected to every plot, ensures a clean, odour-free and mosquito-free environment. With an advanced Sewage Treatment Plant, wastewater is purified and reused for greenery uniting hygiene with sustainability.
infrastructure.storm_water_drainage: Modern Storm Water drains constructed on either side of the roads have recharge pits at frequent intervals. This system not only prevents water logging but also helps increase the groundwater level, maintaining a clean and eco-friendly environment

planned_facilities.description: Moments of leisure turn into timeless experiences at the Recreational Club. Unwind by the swimming pool, revitalize at the modern fitness studio, or enjoy play with engaging indoor games. Savor fine dining at the signature restaurant, or host refined gatherings in elegant meeting spaces.

planned_facilities.name: Media Tower
planned_facilities.headline: A 52-Feet Icon of Innovation
planned_facilities.description: Rising tall at the center of Karthipuram's grand boulevard, the 52-feet Media Tower stands as a symbol of innovation and progress. Equipped with advanced LED pixels and dynamic smart displays, it serves as the Township's hub for real-time information, branding, and interactive experiences. From showcasing community updates, advertisements, and cultural events to streaming global content, the Media Tower transforms the streetscape into a lively, connected environment. By day it commands attention as a modern communication landmark, and by night its vibrant illumination redefines the skyline making it a true icon of Karthipuram's futuristic lifestyle.

planned_facilities.name: Shopping Streets
planned_facilities.headline: Shop At Ease - Shopping Streets
planned_facilities.description: At KARTHIPURAM, shopping is thought not as chores, but as pure choice and charm; it's about living with ease. Over 4 kilometers of wide 80 and 60-feet roads stretch into vibrant shopping streets, uniting essentials and luxuries in one destination. No more wasted hours in traffic, no more crowded lanes. Here, malls, boutique stores, and lifestyle spaces are just steps away. Shopping becomes an effortless elegant world-class experience truly.

planned_facilities.name: Entrance Arch
planned_facilities.description: Grand entrance arch bearing the name 'Karthi Puram' in English and 'கார்த்தி புரம்' in Tamil, with a clock tower and lion sculptures.

environment_and_climate.headline: Breathe Easy, Live Naturally, Wake-up Fresh
points: Located in an altitude that is highest in the surrounding region take a good view of the Nilgiri Mountains in the north and a beautiful sunset amidst the Aanaikatti hills in the west.
Enjoy a cool breeze in the evening that will put you to a rejuvenating sleep preparing you for the day ahead.

Surrounded by lush greenery and countless trees, the township thrives in Coimbatore's naturally cool climate. This perfect harmony of nature and weather creates a refreshing, balanced environment, ensuring comfort, health and a vibrant way of living year-round.

founder_message.heading: A LANDMARK OF LUXURY CRAFTED WITH LIFE
founder_message.text: Having created a legacy of success across diverse industries, the Unnamalai Group now proudly presents its next Landmark Project KARTHIPURAM. Crafted to be more than just a Township, Karthipuram is a grand urban masterpiece designed to astonish not only Tamilnadu but all of India. Envisioned with foresight, this Township has been built with world-class amenities and futuristic infrastructure to serve generations to come. Karthipuram is destined to become a hub of progress, comfort, and lifestyle excellence for the entire Coimbatore region and its surroundings. With this creation, we are setting a new benchmark in real estate and city planning, redefining what it means to live in luxury and convenience. It gives us immense pride and joy to present this prestigious creation Anbudan KARTHIPURAM.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Karthipuram
welcome.text:
At the heart of Coimbatore, celebrated as the Manchester of South India, emerges KARTHIPURAM, a 190-acre visionary Township built on purpose. Crafted with 80 and 60-feet roads stretching over 4 kms, it seamlessly blends a vibrant commercial hub with elegant residential plots.

Here, modern infrastructure meets premium living, bringing together parks, schools, restaurants, offices, jewellery boutiques, textiles showrooms and everything from watches to footwear all in one destination. No more scattered shopping across the city, The Future of world-class living and retail begins here.

taglines: Step through the door to your dream place
Built with vision, touched with soul, a world of living that feels whole.
A Landmark of Luxury Crafted with Life
